name: space-picker
title: Space Picker
description: SpaceChip — a space as a quiet property chip (tile, name, chevron) — and SpacePicker, that chip opening a searchable list of spaces with My space first, a check on the current one and disabled rows that say why.

meta.whenToUse: Choosing or showing which space a record lives in, in a create dialog title or a property row.
meta.whenNotToUse: Choosing anything that is not a space (SearchableSelect, Combobox).
